results.actual: Existing gated-pipeline tests retained planning suppression for insufficient evidence.
Unknown-node/negative malformed incident request returned 422.
Raw JSON +Infinity concentration returned 201 and was retrievable; NaN/-Infinity failed.
Duplicate sensor/time sample and 26-year-old sample were accepted and incremented evidence/sample count.
No dedicated full-pipeline contradictory/bias/outlier trajectory was run; sensor-health unit coverage is not an end-to-end authority proof.
V4 gating support tests passed for calibration and disagreement suppression.
V4 calibration gating tests passed; invalid/missing calibration did not permit planning.
OOD unit and V4 gating tests passed, including topology-related suppression.
A DEMO_FALLBACK analysis reports planning_allowed=false, yet POST /workflow returns HUMAN_APPROVAL with VERIFIED.
Existing response-planning and live-verification tests passed their constraint rejection controls.
Injected timeout, incomplete, and unstable simulator failures all produced ABSTAINED, never VERIFIED.
Live exposure-verification support tests passed hydraulic/service constraint controls.
After verification, replacing stored plan actions while retaining plan_id allowed approval because approval binds no plan-content hash.
New evidence marked verification stale and approval returned 409, including after restart.

Replacing an existing network id through the normal validation route did not invalidate a verified plan; approval succeeded. This route requires injected-verifier mode, but demonstrates absent current network identity in approval context.
Premature and REJECTED-plan approvals returned 409.
Two serial identical approval requests both returned 200 and append approval events despite incident already CLOSED.
No deterministic instrumentation point exists around approval context recheck; concurrent evidence/approval race not proven.
No deterministic synchronization seam exists between verification completion and approval; concurrent race not proven.
Restart test preserved stale state and blocked approval.
A syntactically valid forged reference artifact with an intentionally wrong artifact_sha256 was served 200; endpoint parses JSON but validates neither checksum nor event chain.
LIVE example inputs are cached for app lifetime but payload exposes no cache/computation provenance field; reference endpoint also does not verify artifact integrity at serve time.
Oversized body returned 413 and invalid Content-Length returned 400 before incident creation.
Direct IDLE -> HUMAN_APPROVAL controller transition raised ValueError.
No property-based API fuzzer was added; malformed hand probes were prioritized after the four reproducible authority failures.
Reference artifact generation/replay and endpoint support tests passed deterministic/hash-chain controls for the committed artifact.
